title: Changelog scroll
label: A parchment scroll hangs from a wooden roller and unrolls downward, one release at a time. Each release row, with its version, date and a few changes tagged New, Improved or Fixed, is inked as it appears: the writing goes on wet and blue-black, then settles to its normal tone, and the tag stamps press in. Older rows fade toward a brown, aged ink as newer ones arrive. A tally beside the scroll counts the stamped changes by tag. Before the loop ends the scroll rolls back up into its roller.
heading:
Every release,
put in writing.
sub: Each version is inked the day it ships. The older entries settle into the record.

items: Offline edits sync in the background
Dashboards load in half the time
